tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi bde chen 'od 'bar nyi gzhon gyis// nyes tshogs sgrib gnyis mun pa gtan 'joms shing*// ye shes snang ba mtha' dag gsal mdzad pa// rdo rje slob dpon gus pa'i gtsug gis bsten// rab 'byams rgyud sde'i phrin las bsgrub pa la// me yi mchod sbyin rnam pa kun sgrub gces// rdo rje can gyis yang yang bsngags pa'i phyir// lhag bsam dkar pos dag gsal bsdus te bshad// 'dir rdo rje theg pa la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis rang gi 'dod lha yongs su mnyes pa dang*/ sngags kyi nus pa 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub pa'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la rnam pa kun tu 'bad par rigs so// de lta na sbyin sreg byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de'i phan yon/ shes bya'i rnam gzhag gtan la dbab pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje'i gur las/ sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor sngags shes shing*// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ sbyin sreg gi ni las bya zhing*// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so// gnyis pa phan yon ni/ gur las/ gang gis sbyin sreg ma byas na// 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan dag tu// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces dang*/ kha che rin chen rdo rjes/ sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi ster// zhes dang*/ gur las/ 'di yis rdo rje can mnyes shing*// ye shes me yang rab mnyes so| |zhes dang*/ sambu ṭa las/ sna tshogs las ni rab bsgrub phyir// sbyin sreg las ni rab bshad bya// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so// gsum pa shes bya'i rnam gzhag gtan la dbab pa la gsum/ phyi/ nang*/ gsang ba'o// dang po phyi cho ga'i spros bcas kyi sbyin sreg la gnyis/ dngos 'byor dang yid sprul lo// dang po la gnyis/ lag tu blang ba'i rim pa dang*/ ngag 'don cho ga'i rnam gzhag go// dang po la bsdoms bcu gnyis te/ sa phyogs dus tshod thab khung dang*/ */sgrub po bud shing me me lha// dgang blugs mchod rdzas sreg rdzas dang*// sngags tshig bkod gshom rnal 'byor ro// dang po sa phyogs ni/

sambu ṭa las/ shar gyi phyogs su zhi ba yin/ */lho yi phyogs su mngon spyod yin// nub tu dbang dang dgug pa ste// byang du rgyas pa'i thab khung nyid// ces gsungs pas/ sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na/ grong khyer sogs kyi shar phyogs su zhi ba/ byang du rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ lhor drag po rnams dang*/ sgrub dkyil dang 'brel na dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor zhi ba sogs so/ */gnyis pa dus tshod ni/ sgeg pa'i rdo rjes/ zhi ba ni dbyar bya'o// rgyas pa ni ston gyi dus so// dbang ni dpyid kyi dus so// drag po ni dgun gyi dus te dus kyi rim pa'o// zhes so// tshes grangs ni/ dgra nag las/ tshes gcig la ni zhi ba bya// zla ba nya la rgyas pa ste// bcu bzhi la ni mngon spyod do// dbang gi las ni tshes brgyad la// zhes so// thun tshod ni/ nag po pas/ zhi ba phal cher srod la bya// rgyas pa snga dro bya bar bshad// dbang ni dgong ka'i dus su'o// mngon spyod nam phyed nyin phyed na'o// zhes so// gza' skar ni/ zhi ba la gza' zla ba dang pa sangs/ skar ma khrums smad/ gre/ skag /mchu rnams so// rgyas pa la gza' phur bu dang lhag pa/ skar ma gro bzhin/ mon gru/ snar ma/ snron rnams so// dbang la gza' spen pa/ skar ma rgyal sogs so// mngon spyod la/ gza' mig dmar dang nyi ma/ skar ma bra nye dang mgo sogs so// khyad par du 'char ba dang*/ bdun pa'i dus sbyor la mig dmar dang*/ spen pa/ dus me rnams yod pa ni zhi rgyas la khyad par du spangs te 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa byed pa'i phyir ro// gzhan yang byed pa ngan pa biṣṭi yang 'jam gsum la spangs te dus dge ba la bya'o// yang na/ a ba tā ra las/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du goms pa mang du byas te rab tu rings pa'i sbyin sreg gi las rnams la/ gnas la sogs pa gang yang rung bar ji ltar 'dod pa'i sbyin sreg gi las la rtag tu rnam par rtog pa med pa nyid du rtsol ba dang ldan par las sgrub pa pos bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa thab khung gi rnam gzhag ni/

sngar sbyangs zin pa'i sar ni sa chog mi dgos la/ sbyangs ma zin pa'i sar ni sa bslang sbyang bzung ba rnams rang gzhung ltar ram| de tsam mi nus na/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ zhing skyong dang sa'i lha mo la gtor ma sbyin zhing*/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas gzhi der reg cing*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ 'dod lha'i gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla ba kun rdzob pa'i sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad stong nyid mnyam pa nyid du bsam pa don dam pa'i sbyang ba'o// de ltar sbyangs zin nas thab/ 'bri/ rko/ rtsig gsum las gang byed kyang stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du 'bri na/ kho bos bgyis pa'i thig rtsa rdo rje'i phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar thig btab/ rtsig na las bzhi ka'i thab kyi rgya tshad thig rtsa ltar la dpangs su de'i sum gnyis/ thab kyi steng nas phyi rol tu mchu dma' ba thab kyi bcu drug cha'i steng nas thab kyi brgyad cha'i mchu 'jam gsum la nang dang*/ drag po la phyir bcu drug cha bgos kyis dma' ba/ mchu'i steng nas brgya dpangs snga ma lta bu'i kha khyer 'jam gsum la nang dang*/ drag po la phyir bgos kyis dma' ba brko na yang mchu dma' ba dang*/ thab kyi zabs brkos la/ mchu brgyad cha dor ba nas/ brgyad cha'i dpangs can gyi kha khyer sbyar/ gzhan rnams snga ma ltar byas pas 'grub la| brko na thab kyi dpangs dang mnyam pa'i stegs bu byas pa la rko yi/ rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi la rko ba ni min no// brtsig na tshad dang ldan pa brtsigs pa'i thab mtshan rnams 'bur du dod pa bya dgos so// de yang thig rtsar sor mo sogs kyi grangs bshad pa ni tshad can grags che ba'i dbang du byas mod/ tshad med la ni de kho nar yang ma nges ste/ sdom 'byung las/ sor brgyad pa nas brtsis nas ni// ji srid khru stong bar du'o// zhes gsungs pas/ tshad can spyir btang tsam nas gnas dus sogs la dpags te bya'o/

tshon ni/ nag po pas/ rdul tshon gyis ni rdzogs par bri// yang na me tog dag kyang rung*// zhes pas/ zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag pos 'bri yi/ skabs 'dir tshon sna tshogs sgrig pa la 'brel med/ rtsig pa dang rko ba'ang kha dog snga ma dang mtshungs/ de tsam mi nus na me tog gi tshom bus kyang rung bar bshad ma thag pa'i lung gis grub bo/ sna tshogs padma ni phyogs bzhi dmar/ me rlung ser/ bden bral ljang*/ dbang ldan sngo/ lte ba ljang ser bya/ yang na las mthun gyis chog go// las 'jam gsum la ba lcis byugs par bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'i dri dang me tog dkar ser dmar po dang*/ drag po la bdud rtsi dang bcas pa'i ro thal nag po dang bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs dang*/ dri ngan pa'am dri med pa'i me tog sngo nag dang 'bru'i sbun pa gcal du bkram mo// bzhi pa sgrub pa po ni/ kha sbyor las/ dang po sngags pas 'bum bzlas nas// phyis nas las 'di yang dag brtsam// zhes dang*/ gdan bzhi las/ sngon du me yi las sogs la// blo can bzlas pa shes par bya// zhes gsungs pas dbang thob cing dam sdom dang ldan pa'i sngags pas bsnyen pa tshad du langs par byas nas/ sbyin sreg la 'jug pa'i tshe/ las 'jam po gsum la khrus bya/ lus dri zhim pos byug /de yang zhi ba la dri dang gos rgyan dkar pos spras te ku sha'i khri la padma'i 'dug stangs te/ byin pa g.yas par g.yon pa bzhag te pus mo gnyis smad pa/ rgyas pa la gos rgyan dri sogs ser po dang ldan pas khri stan mthon po'i khar bzang po'i 'dug stangs te/ rkang pa gnyis drang por bsrangs nas byams bzhugs kyis 'dug go// dbang la dri gos rgyan phreng dmar po dang ldan pas mtho zhing bde ba'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil krung ste/ brla dang byin pa g.yas pa'i dbus su rkang pa g.yon pa bzhag /de'i steng du brla dang byin pa g.yon pa'i dbus su rkang pa g.yas pa bzhag la 'dug go// drag po la khrus mi bya bar/

dri mi zhim pa dang dug khrag dang ro sol gyis byugs/ gos rgyan nag po'am mi lpags sogs gyon nas stan sra mkhregs rtsub pa'am/ sgrub bya'i gzugs kyi snying gar ram/ dur khrod kyi ras kyi steng du tsog puu'i 'dug stangs te rkang pas rkang pa mnan pa'am/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas 'dug cing sbrul dang mi rus kyis brgyan/ zhi ba la zhi ba'i bsam pa byams pa dang snying rje/ rgyas pa la dga' spro tshim zhing gzengs bstod pa'i bsam pa/ dbang la brtse zhing gcugs pa chags pa'i bsam pa/ drag po la rgyu'i kun slong snying rje dang*| dus kyi kun slong khro 'khrug rngam rtsub kyi bsam pas/ sos so 'cha' zhing mig gdong tshugs/ bzhin khro gnyer can du bya'o// gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ sham thabs bla gos rnam par spang*// gos gzhan dag ni bkag ma yin// shin tu drag por de mi rung*// zhes spyir sbyin sreg gi tshe sham thabs dang bla gos spang zhing*/ drag po la ni shin tu yang spang*| |yang de nyid las/ phyag rgya gtsug phud lnga bcings nas// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ thor tshugs sogs longs sku'i cha lugs las mthun gyi kha dog can du bya'o// gzhan yang dgang blugs 'dzin pa'i tshul yang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ zhi la byang chub mchog gis bzung*// rgyas la rin chen khu tshur gyis// dbang dang dgug pa dag la yang*// padma'i khu tshur gyis ni bzung*// de bzhin khro bo'i khu tshur gyis// nan tan du ni gdug la bya// zhes pas rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis brkyangs pa rin po che'i khu tshur/ bsdams pa las srin lag brkyangs pa padma'i khu tshur/ bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyangs pa khro bo'i khu tshur yin la/ de yang las 'jam po gsum la rang rang gi khu tshur gyi lag g.yon pas dgang gzar dang*/ g.yas pas blugs gzar bzung nas pus mo las mi 'da' bar g.yas su lan gsum bskor nas dbul zhing*/

drag po la ni khro bo'i khu tshur gyis snga ma las go ldog pa dang*/ 'jam gsum la me lha zhal cung zad gdangs par snyan pa'i gdangs dang*/ drag po la me lha zhal cher gdangs pa la nga ro drag pos dbul/ bsgrub bya la/ zhi rgyas gnyis ni bdag gzhan gnyis ka dang*/ dbang drag ni gzhan kho nar bya bar gsungs so// lnga pa bud shing ni/ zhi ba la nimba sogs mchog sbyin gyi shing ngam/ nags kyi ba glang gi lci ba/ rgyas pa la nimba'am/ shing 'bras bu can kham star shug pa la sogs pa/ dbang la nimba'am/ shing skyur po me tog dmar ba dang*/ tsher ma lcags kyu 'dra ba/ de gsum ni rlan dang bral zhing srog chags med pa/ drag po la tsha ba dang*/ kha ba dang*/ tsher ma can dang*/ dri ngan pa'am/ dri med pa'am/ dur khrod kyi shing dang*/ dug shing ngam/ bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs sogs shin tu skam pa rnams so// de dag kyang 'jam gsum la mar khu dang dri bzang gis sbags pa/ drag po la zhun chen dang dug khrag gis sbags pa/ rtsig pa'i tshe zhi ba la thab las cung zad dma' ba/ rgyas pa la thab dang mnyam pa/ dbang drag la ji ltar 'byor ba rnams thab so so bzhin du rtsig gam nang du dgang*/ me tshang ni/ dā ri ka pas las mthun gyi phyogs su bca' bar gsungs pas/ zhi ba la shar/ rgyas pa la byang*/ dbang la nub/ drag po la lho'am/ yang na bzhi ga la shar lho me lha'i gnas su bca'o// drug pa me dang me lha ni/ zhi ba'i me shing 'o ma can dang mchod sbyin gyi shing las byung ba'i me dang*/ tha mal pa dgon pa'i me dang bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gi me dang*/ sbyin sreg byas pa'i shul gyi me rnams gang rung*/ rgyas pa la rgyal po'am/ rgyal rigs kyi khyim nas byung ba'i me'am/ nags mes tshig pa dang*/ me shel las byung ba'i me'am/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mang gi me rnams gang rung*/ dbang la smad 'tshong ma dang rje rigs kyi khyim gyi me'am/ me tog dmar po can gyi shing gtsubs pa las byung ba'am/

gar mkhan dang tshong pa dang sprang pos lam du bud pa'i me rnams gang rung*/ drag po la ro bsregs pa dang*/ rdo dang lcags brdabs pa dang*/ dur khrod kyi shing dang*/ gdol pa dang shan pa'i khyim gyi me gang rung rnams so// sbar shing yang 'jam gsum la shing skam po khru gang la ras dkar dkris pa mar dkar gyis byugs pa dang*/ drag po la tsher ma can rlon pa du ba dang bcas pa ro ras kyis dkris pa/ til mar dang dug khrag gis sbags pa'o// sbar ba'i tshe 'jam gsum gyi thab la g.yas dang drag po la g.yon du lan gsum bskor nas las dang rjes mthun pa'i phyogs nas sbar te/ gsang ldan gyis/ zhi ba ni shar du gzhug go// rgyas pa ni byang nas so// dbang ni nub nas so// drag po ni lho nas so| |zhes gsungs so// me pra brtag pa ni/ sdom 'byung sogs nas me lha'i byon zan phul ba'i de ma thag tu yin par gsungs pa ltar 'thad kyi/ 'ga' zhig gis thog mtha' kun tu brtag par sems pa ni ha cang yun ring ba'i rkyen la brten pa'i 'bar lugs sna tshogs srid pas yid brtan med do// de yang sngags pa dam sdom la gnas shing rim gnyis la goms pa sngon song can la dgongs so// me pra yang me'i kha dog dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ dbyibs bzhi'i sgo nas brtag ste/ sdom 'byung las/ mkhas pas mdog dang sgra dang ni// dri dang 'bar ba'i dbyibs brtag ste// zhes so// de yang zhi ba la chu shel ltar dkar ba/ rgyas pa la gser ltar ser ba/ dbang la padma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ drag po la margad ltar ljang ba/ thams cad kyang mdangs bkrag cing snum la 'od 'phro ba/ sgra ni rnga/ sil/ dung dang*/ pi waṃ/ rdza rnga'i skad ltar snyan pa/ dri ni padma dang*/ utpal/ rgya spos/ ga pur/ a ga ru ltar zhim zhing sim pa/ dbyibs ni zhi ba la rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ rgyas pa la rin chen cha dgu pa/ dbang la padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ drag po la ral gri dang rgya gram lta bu/

de yang sgra dang dri ni 'jam gsum la snga ma lta bu/ drag po la de las ldog pa/ gzhan yang 'jam gsum la bkra shis rtags brgyad/ 'phan/ rnga yab/ dgang blugs/ kha ṭwāṃ sogs kyi gzugs sam/ rtse mo gcig pa dang*/ g.yas su 'khor ba dang*/ du ba med pa sogs bzang zhing*/ drag po la de las ldog pa'o// rgyas par sdom 'byung las/ me ni rtse mo gcig 'bar ba// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad byed// rtse mo gnyis ni ma bkug par// kun tu 'bar ba 'bring zhes bya// rtse mo bzhi ni mnyam 'bar bas// rgyas pa'i dngos grub brtan par gnas// kunda zla ba dang mtshungs snum// gzugs bzang bai ḍūrya yi 'od// dri bral du ba med pa'i me// nad med pa dang rigs 'phel byed// zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od// kha ba yi ni mdog lta bu// puṣpa rā ga'i mdog mtshungs pa// sdig pa thams cad zhi bar byed// me tog bandhu ka mtshungs shing*// dza ba'i me tog dang 'dra ba// btso ma gser gyi mdog lta bu| |dbang phyug rgyal srid rab tu ster// tsampa ka dang utpal dri// u shir mā la ti pī ta// ga pur a ga ru yi dris// dge zhing gnas kyi bdag po mchog /pi waṃ rgyud mang rdza rnga dang*| |dung dang zangs dung ltar sgra snyan// shin tu zab pa sgra snyan pa'i// me mthong bde ba 'byung bar byed// dpal be'u gdugs dang chu skyes dang*// rtse gsum pa dang bum pa'i dbyibs| |rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdo rje bzang*// g.yu drung rta dang glang po'i dbyibs// sgra med g.yas su 'khyil ba dang*// dum bu gcig pas don chen ster// 'di dag dge ba phun sum tshogs// tshe dang nad med phun sum tshogs// zhes sogs dang*/ ngan pa ni/ yang de nyid las/ g.yo zhing mdun gyi phyogs su 'bar// rtse gsum du ba'i tshogs mang dang*// 'khor zhing me stag dang bcas pa// rnam par 'phro bas nad 'phel byed// me gang yang yang rab tu 'dar// yang yang rab tu rgod pa dang*// yang yang g.yon du 'khor ba dang*// yang yang sa la reg byed cing*// thig le nag po sol ba'i mdog

/myur du rigs ni zad 'gyur nges// gang zhig rgyal po'i drung gnas pa'i// sde dang bdag po 'joms par ston// mdog ngan du ba'i mdog ltar gnag /mdog ljang sna tshogs mdog rtsub pa// pa lā sha dang 'bru mar mdog /'dod pa'i don rnams nyams par byed// ro dri nya yi dri ltar ngan// chu skyes srog chags dri dang ldan// gal te me ni 'di ltar 'gyur// gtso bo rnam par ltung bar brjod// tsa ṭa tsa ṭa zhes sgra dang*// tshaṃ tshaṃ zhes pa'i sgra dag dang*// siṃ siṃ gyi ni sgra bdag nyid// rdo yi sgra ni don nyams byed// mdung dang ral gri mda' dang sbrul// rnga mong ba glang mgo lta bu// 'jigs rung rnam pa gang de mthong*// zhes sogs mang du gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha dog skya zhing mi snum pa sogs dang*/ dbyibs mi legs shing khwa ta'i skad dang*/ tog tog tshag tshag dang*/ rdo brdabs pa dang*/ ser ba 'bab pa'i sgra lta bu dang*/ ro dang srog chags kyi dri lta bu dang*/ thur du 'khyil zhing g.yon du 'khor ba dang*/ me lce chad cing me stag 'phro ba/ 'bar dka' ba sogs ngan par bshad la/ gzhan yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ sreg pa'i rang bzhin myur tshig pa'i// me ni mi dge ba ru 'dod// ces sreg rdzas tshig pa ha cang myur ches pa dang*/ sngags mkhan me'i tsha gdung gis ha cang gdung ches pa mi dge bar bshad la/ gzhan yang 'di lta bu'i skabs su la nye brtag pa ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ gzhan yang la nye bzang po dang*// 'dab chags dga' ba'i sgra dag dang*// rnam pa sna tshogs nges pa'i sgra// rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags pa dang*// bkra shis bzang por rab bsngags dang*// rnam pa sna tshogs yid 'ong sgra// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*// de bzhin mchod yon bum pa gang*// mthong na 'grub pa'i rgyu rnams dang*// rnam pa du ma'i kha dog gam// 'jig rten gyis mchod rab bsngags pa// de dag mthong na 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de ltar 'jam gsum la dge ba'i ltas ni drag po la mi dge zhing*/

'jam gsum la mi dge ba'i ltas ni drag po la dge bar 'gyur te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dge la mi shis gsungs pa gang*// de ni gdug pa'i las la shis// mngon spyod la ni mi shis gang*// de ni dge la shis par 'dod// ces so// ngan na de dag zhi ba'i cho ga 'chad 'gyur ltar bya'o// me pra brtag pa dang la nye brtag pa ni de ltar gsungs mod/ 'dir kha cig gis mchod rdzas la pra brtag pa mthong gi/ rgyud dang paṇa grub kyi gzhung gang las kyang ma gsungs pas rnam par 'khyams so// me lha ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ ngas byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas ni me bcu gnyis bstan te/ zhes pa nas/ sems can rmugs par byed pa'o// zhes las kyi dbye bas me lha rigs bcu gnyis gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhi ba'i me lha 'dzin byed sku mdog dkar po chu dkyil la gnas pa/ dkar/ nag /dmar ba'i zhal gsum 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa/ zhi ba'i nyams can/ gos dkar po dang srad bu dkar po/ me lce dkar po/ padma'i skyil krung*/ rgyas pa'i me lha dbang chen sku mdog ser po sa dkyil la gnas pa/ ser/ dkar/ sngo ba'i zhal gsum bzhad cing cher gdangs pa/ rgyas pa'i nyams can/ gos ser po dang srad bu ser po/ me lce ser po/ bzang po'i 'dug stangs/ dbang gi me lha dmar po sku mdog dmar po me dkyil la gnas pa/ dmar/ dkar/ nag pa'i zhal gsum 'dzum bag can 'gying ba/ chags pa'i nyams can/ gos dmar po dang srad bu dmar po/ me lce dmar po/ rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ drag po'i me lha rlung chen sku mdog nag po rlung dkyil la gnas pa/ nag /dkar/ dmar ba'i zhal gsum ches cher gdangs pa/ khro 'khrug khams gsum za ba/ gos nag po dang srad bu nag po/ me lce nag po g.yas brkyang gis/ rgyas 'debs kyi lha zhi ba la rnam snang*/ rgyas pa la rin 'byung*/ dbang la snang mtha'/ drag po la don grub/ bstod pa'i tshe/ zhi ba la/

'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// rgyas pa la/ dbang chen me lha/ dbang la/ dmar po me lha/ drag po la/ rlung chen me lha zhes so sor bsgyur/ 'das pa'i me lha bskyed tshul yang*/ sdom 'byung las/ me lha'i thugs kar nges par lha// sbyin sreg dngos grub rab tu ster// zhes dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo dang bcas pa// drang srong snying gar bsgom par bya// zhes so// yang na de nyid snang ba las/ me lha 'bar ba'i gzugs can zhu bar gyur pa'i dbus su/ zhes gsungs pas/ me lha'i thugs ka'am/ me lha me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur pa'i dbus su sgom pa gnyis gang bde byas pas rung ngo*// bdun pa dgang blugs ni/ rgyu dang tshad dbyibs sogs rgya cher gsungs pa rnams deng sang grub zin las sbyin sreg gi tshe gsar du 'chos pa nyung bas mkho khebs chung phyir ma bris la/ gal te dgang blugs dngos su ma 'byor na lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga sbyar bas dgang gzar dang*/ g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum sbyar bas blugs gzar bya zhing*/ dgang blugs gang rung gcig 'byor na des gnyis ka'i bya ba byar rung ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ sor mo lnga ni rab sbyar ba'i// dgang blugs su ni yang dag mtshungs// gzhan la sor mo gsum po dag /bshibs pa yis ni sreg blugs sbyin// zhes so// yang na shing pi pal la sogs sam byang chub kyi shing gi lo mas kyang dgang blugs byar rung ba 'od snye las gsungs so// brgyad pa mchod rdzas ni/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na rnam rgyal bum pa nas chu blug cing 'jam gsum la spos zhim po dang*/ drag po la gu gul gyis bdugs/ zhi ba la/ dung ngam/ nya lcibs kyi snod du 'o ma dang*/ shu dag dang*/ me tog dkar po dang*/ dri'i chu dkar po/ rgyas pa la/ gser dngul gyi snod du zho dang*/ me tog ser po dang*/ dri'i chu ser po/ dbang la/ zangs kyi snod du me tog dmar po dang*/

dri'i chu dmar po/ de gsum ga la til nag /ku sha/ 'bras yos/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams sbyar ba'i chu bzhi/ drag po la longs spyad pa'i rdza phor chag pa'i dum bu'am/ mi'i thod pa dri nga ba'am/ dri med pa'i me tog sngo nag dang*/ bong bu dang ba'i lci ba dang*/ dug khrag dang sbyar ba'i chu bzhi/ de thams cad la gtso bo'i sngags sam las sngags mthar/ zhi ba la swā hā/ rgyas pa la om̐/ dbang la hrīḥdang hoḥ drag po la phaṭa sbyar ba'i brgya'am nyer gcig bzlas pas dgang ngo*// gzhan yang rin chen 'bar ba las/ me tog la sogs rdzas rnams ni// las kyi dbye bas kha dog dbye// zhes gsungs pas/ zhi ba la dri zhim pa'i me tog dkar po/ rgyas pa la dri zhim pa'i me tog ser po/ dbang la dri zhim pa'i me tog dmar po/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la ga pur dang a ga ru la sogs pa'i spos dri zhim pa/ mar dkar gyi mar me/ tsandan sogs kyi dri chab rnams las mthun gyis kha dog bsgyur ba/ zhi ba la 'o mas sbrus pa'i lha bshos/ rgyas pa la zho dang*/ dbang la mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa/ drag po la dri nga ba dang dri med pa dang tsher ma can gyi me tog /spos dkar/ gu gul/ sha chen bsres pa'i bdug spos/ mi rta khyi nya la sogs pa'i zhun/ yungs mar dang til mar sogs sbyar ba'i mar me/ tu ruṣka dang 'o ma sogs dug khrag dang sbyar ba yid du mi 'ong ba'i dri chab/ ro kha ba dang tsha ba sogs yid du mi 'ong ba'i bza' ba sna tshogs sha khrag dang sbyar ba'i lha bshos/ 'jam gsum la las kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i gos zung 'jig 'das gnyis la re re/ drag po la ro ras nag po'am/ ro nag gi zhing lpags kyi gos zung gnyis/ har ta/ su pa ri/ kastu ri/ sgog skya/ mon sran/ zho sha mngar gsum dang sbyar ba'i so rtsi 'jam gsum la rdo thal spang zhing*/ drag po la rdo thal dang bcas pa rnams las mthun gyis kha dog bsgyur ba dag go// dgu pa sreg rdzas ni/ zhi rgyas la yam shing gi rgyu/

sangs rgyas thod pa las/ a shwattha dang n+ya gro dha// u duṃ wā ra parka ṭī// pa lā sha ste shing lnga las// zhes bshad kyang de dag bod du med pas 'o ma can cha 'dra ba bal bu dang*/ 'om bu/ kham bu/ shug pa/ lcang skya/ thang shing sogs dri zhim pa'i shing gi zhi ba la rtse mo'i cha las byung ba srid du sor bcu gnyis dang*/ sboms su mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam pa mnyam par bcad pa/ mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsir bsnyugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri dkar pos byugs pa ste| nag po pas/ yam shing sor ni bcu gnyis pa// de ni zhi ba'i las la shis// zhes so/ rgyas pa la shing de dag gi sked pa'i cha las byung ba/ srid du sor mo bskums pa'i khru gang dang*| sboms su 'chang gang pa mnyam por bcad pa/ zho dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ mngar gsum dang*/ mar gyis byugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri ser pos sbags pa ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ mdzes pa dbus kyi cha las skyes// yam shing gi ni srid kyi tshad// khu tshur bcangs pa'i khru gang tsam// zhes so// dbang la tsandan dmar po'am/ ma rnyed na me tog dmar zhing ro skyur ba'i shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i srid du sor lnga'am/ bcu gnyis dang*/ sboms su mthe'u chung gi phyed tshad tsam pa mar khu dang*/ mngar gsum dang*/ pho mo'i dri chur bsnyugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri dmar pos sbags pa ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ sor mo lnga pa 'dab ldan pa'i// yam shing dbang gi las la sbyar// zhes dang*/ yang na nag po pas/ dbang dang dgug pa zhi dang 'dra// zhes so// de gsum ga'i rtse mo padma'i dbyibs lta bu'o// drag po la tsher ma can gyi shing ro kha ba'am/ tsha ba me tog sngon po'am/ nag po 'char ba dug dang bcas pa'i shing ngam/ yang na ro bsregs pa'i 'gal dum ste/ de dag gi rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba srid du sor mo bcu dang sboms su srin mdzub tsam pa rtse mo gnyis rnon por bzhogs pa la/ khyi brun dang*/

dug khrag /yungs mar/ ske tshe/ lan tshwa sogs kyis sbags shing bdud rtsi dang*/ dri sngon po'am/ nag po dang*/ shi yug gi skra bsres pa ste/ nag po pas/ mngon spyod la ni sor bcu'o// zhes so// de dag kyang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ rdol dang gas dang rul ba dang*// yon po thung ngu de bzhin ring*// sbom dang 'bu yis zos pa dang*// rtse mo'i cha ni gas pa dang*// srin bu rnams dang ldan pa nyid// 'di kun dge ba'i las la ni// spangs te mi dge ba la blang*// zhes dang*/ 'od snye las/ rnying lci phra dang skyog po dang*// ring thung lo ma med pa dang*// srog chags kyis zos rul ba dang*// shun bral chag dang bu ga can// rtse mo rno ldan sbom pa spang*// zhes dang*/ de dag gi nyes pa ni/ rnying pa yis ni 'chi bar 'gyur// skyog pos skal pa ngan par 'gyur// ring thung rig pa 'phral du nyams// lo ma med pas na tsha 'byung*// sbom pos phun sum tshogs pa nyams// skam pos gzhan yang mi 'dod pa// zhes gsungs pas/ 'jam gsum la skyon de rnams shin tu spangs pa dang*/ drag po la skyon de rnams dang ldan pa nyid dgos so// des na 'jam gsum gyi yam shing rlan bcas pags pa dang ldan pa lo ma zung sogs dang ldan par bya zhing*/ drag po la skam po shun pa dang lo ma med pa dgos te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ drag po'i las la shing skam ste// zhes gsungs so// las bzhi'i yam shing gi tshad mi 'dra ba mang du rgyud dang paṇa grub kyi bzhed par snang yang 'dir grags che ba rnams bris so// rdzas lhag ma ni/ 'jam gsum la mar dkar/ drag po la mi la sogs pa'i zhun mar mar nag dang bsres shing dug khrag gis sbags pa/ kha cig tu dbang la tsha ba'i til mar bshad pa dag ma dag brtag dgos so// ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams shing 'dab ma ma grug pa mar dang 'o mas sbags pa/ dūrba sngo ljang shun pa dang lo ma ma nyams pa rtsa rtse tshang ba 'o mas sbags pa/

mngar gsum/ dkar gsum/ 'bras chan dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog /'bras sā lu ma btsos shing ma grug pa/ so ba shun pa dang ma bral ba/ til nag /yungs kar/ nas| gro/ sran ma rnams sbun pa sa rdo sogs lhad dang bral ba/ a bar skyur gsum/ rgun 'brum/ kham star sogs shing thog sna tshogs rnams gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba la/ las so so'i mdog mthun gyi dri dang bdud rtsis sbags pa/ khyad par ba'i sreg rdzas/ zhi ba la/ tsandan dkar po dang*/ pri yang ku dang*/ thang chu dang*/ dri zhim zhing dkar ba'i me tog sna tshogs dang*/ 'bras yos rnams sbrang rtsis sbags pa dang*/ rgyas pa la/ 'bras sā lu/ til nag /zho zan/ zhun mar/ padma ge sar/ nā ga ge sar rnams sbrang rtsis sbags pa/ dbang la/ utpal dang*/ tsampa ka dang*/ mya ngan med dang*/ nā ga ge sar dang*/ me tog dmar zhing ro skyur ba tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa'i rigs rnams so// drag po la/ yungs kar/ nyung dmar/ tsha ba gsum/ lan tshwa/ ske tshe/ nimba'i lo ma/ ro thal/ bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs/ khyim bya'i tshil/ tsher ma/ mi rus kyi phye ma/ zi ra dkar nag /lcags phye/ zangs phye/ gzas po'i rkang rjes kyi rdul rnams bsres pa dug khrag gis sbags pa/ ro bsregs pa'i thal sol dang phub ma sogs dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i liṅga'i snying gar gzas po'i ming rus da dhu ra'i khu ba dug khrag dang bsres pas bris pa bcug cing*/ gzugs de dag gzas po'i dri ma drug gang rnyed kyis sbags pa/ bgegs la byed na de'i ming dang de nyid gnas pa'i sa chu shing sogs kyang bsre'o// gzugs de gnyis kar dug sna dang khrag sna byug go// de rnams kyi dgos pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/ de nas gzhan yang sbyin sreg gi// yan lag kun 'byung 'bras rab bshad// sa dang sa gzhi zhing bcas pa'i// thabs kyi yan lag yon bdag rgyas// mar gyis 'byor pa thams cad byed// yam shing gzi byin rnam par 'phel// bud shing lhag par dpa' bar byed// ku shas thams cad srung bar byed// yungs kar gyis ni bgegs zhi byed// 'bras kyis rgyas par byed par bshad| |til gyis sdig pa 'joms rig bya// so bas nor dang 'bru rnams 'gugs// sran mas stobs rnams chen por byed// nas kyis rlung gi shugs rab ster// dūrbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed// gro yis nad rnams 'joms par byed// 'o ma sbrang rtsis shes rab 'phel// zas mchog gis ni bde kun ster// mes ni 'dod don dngos grub ster// rang 'dod lhas ni grol ba stsol// lhag ma las ni rjes mthun par// zhi sogs las byas shes par bya// zhes so// de rnams gang du 'bul na 'od snye'i dgongs pas/

mar khu sogs zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal dang*/ yaṃ shing*/ ku sha/ dūrba/ bdug spos/ mi rus kyi phye ma rnams sku'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor/ zho zan dang*/ 'bras chan sogs bza' ba dang*/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung*| til/ nas/ gro/ 'bras/ so ba/ sran ma/ shing thog sogs phyag tu/ dri rnams thugs kar/ me tog rnams dbu la/ zhabs bsil ni zhabs la/ mar me dang mchod yon mdun du 'bul lo// bla med rnams la liṅga ma gtogs las bzhi ga'i sreg rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi lngas bran dgos te/ 'od snye las/ bsreg bya'i rdzas thams cad la bshang ba la sogs pa'i bdud rtsi lngas bran zhing bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor bsgoms pa'i sreg blugs bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bcu pa sngags tshig ni/ gur las/ mthar ni swā hā zhi ba ste// rgyas pa'i dus su bau ṣaṭa dang*// mthar ni hūm̐ phaṭa bsad pa la// dbang dang dgug par dzaḥdang hrīḥ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhi ba la/ sdig sgrib nad gdon gang zhi bar 'dod pa che ge mo shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyas pa la/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor blo gros sogs gang rgyas par 'dod pa che ge mo puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā oṃ/ zhes sam/ che ge mo bau ṣaṭa/ ces dang*/ dbang la/ gang dbang du bya ba che ge mo wa shyaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes sam/ che ge mo ā karṣa ya dzaḥhrīḥ zhes dang*/ drag po la/ gnod byed dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces sogs kha bsgyur ro| |de yang skabs dang sbyar zhing shes na/ spel tshig sogs legs sbyar gyi skad du byas na mchog tu 'gyur la/ ma shes na/ sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ lta bu skabs don bod skad kho nar byas kyang nges par rung ngo*// de yang spel tshig rgyas par na/ yam shing la mtshon te/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi spangs rtogs dang*/ sa lam gyi bar chad sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

'bring du na/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid sogs/ bsdu na/ rdzas so so'i khyad par ba gang yin pa de dag sbyar/ sbyor tshul rgyas par sngags re re la spel tshig re re dang*/ bsdu na/ spel tshig thog mthar sbyar zhing bar skabs su sngags kho na byas kyang rung ba sogs rig pa'i mdas bsnun la bya'o// bcu gcig pa bkod gshom ni/ sambu ṭa las/ sreg rdzas rnams ni g.yas su bzhag /chu yi snod ni g.yon du bzhag /mar gyi snod ni mdun du bzhag |ces gsungs pa ltar/ rdzas la go rim nges pa med kyang 'dir lag tu blang bde ba'i phyir/ yam shing mar khu til yungs kar// zas mchog ku sha durba nas// gro 'bras sran so 'bras bu sogs// zhes pa ltar mar khu mdun nam g.yas zur khad nye ba dang*/ yam shing til nas shing thog gi bar las mthun gyi mdog can gyi stan gyi steng du/ slob dpon gyi g.yas ngos nas rtsar du sbrel ba phreng phyi nang gnyis bshams pa'i thab ngos nang ma mang ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha'i dang*/ phyi ma nyung ba 'jig rten pa'i me lhar bsham/ slob dpon gyi g.yon ngos su stegs kyi khar chu bzhi'i gsang chu'i snod du ku sha dang bcas pa/ gzhan gsum snod chu dang bcas pa las sngags dang hūm̐ bzlas pa bsham/ de dag gi mdun du mañdzi sogs kyi khar so so'i bzed zhal gyi snod kyang bkram/ slob dpon gyi mdun du 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ de'i nang thab khung ngos su 'das pa'i me lha'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ nyer spyod kyi mjug tu so so'i gtor ma gnyis/ las bzhi so so'i lha bshos dang rgyu 'dra ba re re dang*/ de dag gi mthar so so'i gos zung so rtsi dang bcas pa bsham/ nyer spyod kyi mgo pha rgyud la slob dpon gyi g.yas dang ma rgyud la g.yon nas bshams zhing thab la kha phyogs par bya/ yang nyer spyod tshar gnyis/

gtor ma/ gos zung*/ so rtsi rnams slob dpon gyi mdun du ma shong na chu bzhi'i mjug tu bshams te/ mnyam sbyor las/ mchod yon yan lag brgyad ldan pa// mchod pa kun gyi sna la 'god// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// slob dpon gyi mdun du/ lha gnas byas pa'i rdo rje dang dril bu/ de dag gi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba dang*/ gzhan yang nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ rlung g.yab/ sbar shing*/ ku sha/ las bum rnams bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du ma song na bdag bskyed kyi mchod gtor rnams g.yas su bsham/ nye logs su me snod gtsang mar las mthun gyi me dang kha gso ba'i bud shing sngar bshad pa'i las dang rjes su mthun pa yang bkod do// yang nyer spyod rnams g.yas ngos sreg rdzas kyi nang rol du bshams pa la'ang khungs rnam dag yod de/ gur las/ me tog bdug spos mar me dang*// de bzhin dri yi dung chos g.yas// zhes gsungs mod/ 'on kyang mdun du ma shong na g.yon du chu bzhi'i rjes su bsham na g.yas g.yon gyi rdzas rnams cha snyoms shing lung snga ma'i khungs dang sbyar bas snga ma ltar lag len gtsang ngo*// bsham tshul 'di rnams 'jam gsum la yin gyi/ drag po la sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas g.yas g.yon go sa brje zhing mdun dang g.yas kyi nyer mkho rnams ni las bzhi gar mtshungs/ las so so'i rdzas khyad par ba ni sreg rdzas kyi shing thog gi rjes der bsham/ drag po'i liṅga ni lcags snod du gan rkyal du bzhag pa'i mgo slob dpon la bstan cing dgug 'dren dang kha sbyor dbye ba mang du byas te phur thun mtshon cha btab nas g.yas ngos kyi nye logs su bshams/ de ltar gshom pa'i tshe liṅga ma gtogs pa'i sreg rdzas/ mchod rdzas/ dgang blugs la sogs pa'i yo byad thams cad la las bum gyi chus las sngags dang hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod la bsang*/ slob dpon dang thab kyi bar du g.yam pa'am/ shing gi me g.yol la gangs ri'i gzugs bris pa'ang bzhag ste/

gdan bzhi'i gzhan gdan rab dbye dang po las/ ji bzhin gdan gyi gnas su yang*// mtheb sor bcu gnyis dag dang ni// dpangs su khru phyed ldan pa yi// ti se gangs ri mdzes par bzhag /ces gsungs so// gzhan yang nyer mkho'i yo byad gang dgos kyang rig pas dpyad nas tshogs par bya'o// bcu gnyis pa rnal 'byor ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod rab gnas dang slob ma la dbang bskur ba sogs kyi dus su ni/ so so'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya zhing*/ de rnams kyi dus min na sgrub pa po las bum gyi chu dang las sngags dang hūm̐ bzhi pas legs par bsangs te gdan la 'khod nas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nas bzung thun bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed dkyus ltar bsgoms la/ de yang gtso bo'i rtsa zhal dang sku mdog /'khor rnams dang bcas pa las mthun gyi kha dog can du sgom zhing*/ gtso 'khor gyi zhal lhag ma rnams bsgyur mi dgos/ bdag bskyed la bsnyen pa ci grub byas nas thun bsdus te dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor la zhugs/ de nas spro na/ las bum du las kyi lha bskyed cing spyan 'dren mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs dkyil chog ltar bya/ mi spro na/ las sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pas nges par rung gi/ 'dis bsang chu tsam las skabs 'dir bya ba gzhan mi dgos pa'i phyir ro// 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa'i tshe yang zhi ba la dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ rgyas pa la ser po rgyas pa'i nyams can/ dbang la dmar po chags pa'i nyams can| drag po la nag po khro 'khrug rngam pa'i nyams can du bsam/ rtsa zhal dang sku mdog ma gtogs zhal lhag ma bsgyur mi dgos/ gzhan yang rgyas pa'i thab khung gru bzhi ser po/ dbang gi thab khung zla gam dmar po/ drag po'i thab khung gru gsum nag por bsgyur/ sbyin sreg zin nas rgyas pa'i me dri ser po'i chu/ dbang la dri dmar po mngar gsum dang bcas pa/ drag po la dug khrag gi mes gzhil lo// 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa'i snga rol du phrin las bya ba'i tshe/

rgyas pa la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rin 'byung yab yum ser po rgyas pa'i nyams can| gos rgyan ser po can/ rin po che dang bum pa ser po 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i 'khor mang po spro ba dang bcas pas bsgrub bya la dbang bskur zhing rin po che'i char phab pas/ de'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor sogs 'dod pa'i don thams cad shin tu rgyas par bsam/ dbang la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas snang mtha' yab yum dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ padma dang bum pa dmar po 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i 'khor dang bcas pas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu spros/ rang nyid gang 'dod pa'i bsgrub bya bkug pa mdun du 'khod pa la utpal dmar po kha ma phye ba'i mde'u can gyi mdas bsgrub bya'i snying phug cing dbang bskur bas/ de'i sgrib pa sbyangs nas bdag nyid kyi dbang du gyur par bsam/ drag po la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas don grub yab yum nag po khro 'khrug gtum pa'i nyams can/ ral gri dang bum pa nag po 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i 'khor mang po spros pas bsgrub bya bkug nas lha dang phral/ rang gshed phab ste thugs ka nas rdo rje'i me char phab pas bsad nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rnam shes gtso bo'i thugs kar bstims/ phung po de nyid ral gris gtub te lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstabs pas rngam sgra dang bcas gsol bar bsam mo// don gyi snying po ni/ snye ma nyer drug las/ sbyin sreg 'khor dang bcas pa'i de kho na nyid ni stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa nyid do// de'i sbyin sreg mkhan po dang*/ bsreg bya dang*/ sbyin pa'i lha la sogs pa rnams sgyu ma nyid du mos pa kho nas ji skad bshad pa'i cho gas ni yang dag par mngon par 'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu'o// zhes gsungs pas/ bdag dang lha dang rdzas dang yo byad la sogs pa sbyin sreg gi 'khor gsum thams cad sgyu ma lta bu gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i rol pa las ma 'das par byas na phrin las thams cad 'grub par gsungs pas/

sbyin sreg gi dbu zhabs thams cad du don de dag yang dang yang du dran pa gso bar bya ba ni dgos pa'i gtso bo yin gyi/ bdag gzhan lha dang rdzas sogs la gnyis 'dzin a 'thas ther zug 'khrul 'dzin rtag par rlom pa can gyis ni gnas skabs kyi phrin las tsam 'grub kyang mchog gi dngos grub 'byung ba nyin skar tsam mo// gnyis pa ngag 'don cho ga'i rnam gzhag la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ bsang chu ku shas blangs la rang gi g.yon nas thab rdzas rnams g.yas skor du bsangs shing las sngags brjod/ slar nang mchod kyang gong bzhin gtor zhing las sngags kyis bsangs/ bsang chus bsang ba 'di rdor dril byin rlabs kyi rjes su bya ba la khungs med cing*/ sngon du bya ba ni rab 'byor bskyangs dang a bha ya'i lugs so// de nas thal mo ā li kā li yongs su gang ba las/ g.yas g.yon nyi ma dang zla bar bsams la rnam lnga kor te/ rdor dril rab gnas byas zin pa'i rdo rje lag g.yas kyi mthe bong dang ming med kyis blangs shing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣast+waṃ dha ra yā mi hiḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying gar bzung*/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang ming med kyis dril bu blangs shing*/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa hūm̐/ zhes dku g.yon du bzung*/ slar rdo rje snga ma ltar las dril bu nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du lce bskyod nas dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsā li ni pradzñā pā ra mi tā nā da swa bhā wa/ badzra satwa hṛ da ya santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥswā hā/ zhes brjod/ me lha'i mchod rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ las mthun gyi snod so sor me lha'i mchod pa rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/

de bzhin du/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad zhes sbyar la byin gyis brlabs/ de nas gdan bzhi las/ lag gnyis khu tshur kha sbyar zhing*// gung mo gnyis sbyar kun tu blta// phyag rgya 'di ni dag byed pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ lag gnyis kyi khu tshur kha sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis bsgrengs pa rtse sprad pa rdzas rnams la gtad do// oṃ swā hās rdzas rnams bkrus par bsam/ oṃ āḥswā hās yaṃ shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās zhun mar/ oṃ dzrīṃ swā hās 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes rdzas gzhan rnams la gtad de brjod pas/ rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad rnam par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhun mar la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i zhun mar sogs rang rang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing rang rang gi bya ba byed nus pa las mthun gyi kha dog can du gyur par bsam zhing*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya swā hā/ nas shing thog gi bar rang rang gi sngags la mgor oṃ dang mthar swā hā sbyar ba gsum gsum gyis byin gyis brlab bo// 'di ni a ba tā ra las/ mar la sogs pa'i sreg rdzas rnams la rang rang gi snying po sor bzhag ste/ zhi ba la sogs pa'i las sgrub nus pa/ kha dog dkar po la sogs dang ldan par yang byin gyis brlab bo// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// de nas las mthun gyi me de nyid las sngags kyis bsrung zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ las sngags kyis sbar la 'bar ba'i tshe de nyid la sbar zhing*/ dwangs gtsang shing shin tu skam pa'i rtswa'i chun po dang lhan cig tu sbar ba la bsang chu dang las sngags kyis bsangs te/ slar nang mchod kyis g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing bsangs pa du ba med pa thab tu bcug la/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod/

de nas/ hūm̐ zhes rlung g.yab kyis me sbar/ de yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ kha yi rlung gis mi bya ste// rtag tu gos kyi mthas kyang min// rlung g.yab gtsang dang de bzhin gos// lo mas kyang ni rlung g.yab bya// zhes so// me 'bar ba'i tshe las sngags bdun dang mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis me gso/ de nas ku sha sngo ljang dri ma med cing ma gas pa 'dab ma ma grug pa ha cang mi ring ba rnams/ oṃ badzra satwa āḥ zhes bzlas nas/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ zhes ku sha gnyis gnyis thab kyi kha khyer la mdun nas g.yas skor gyis rtse mo shar lho nub byang du phyogs par snga ma'i rtse mo phyi ma'i rtsa bas non par bkram/ de rjes thab khung gi steng du rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i ku sha'i chun po ba lang gi rna ba lta bu ha cang mi ring bas g.yogs so// 'di ni me lha'i gdan du bsam dgos pa tshad ldan mang pos bshad do// de ltar sngon 'gro rnams sdoms su bsdu na/ bsang zhing rdor dril bcang ba dang*// mchod pa byin rlabs rdzas rnams kyang*// bkru sbyang byin rlabs me srung zhing*// byin rlabs las sngags bzlas te sbar/ sbar shing sbar nas bsang zhing bskor// thab bcug rlung g.yab g.yab cing sbar// sreg blugs bdun gyis me gso zhing*// ku sha bkram pa sngon 'gro'i las// zhes so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thab bsang chu dang las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐

'dod lha'i gtso bo'i sa bon gang yin te/ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba de'i dbus su/ a las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ dang bgrang 'phreng yongs su gyur pa las/ skad cig gis rdzogs pa zhi ba'i me lha 'dzin byed sku mdog dkar po chu dkyil la gnas pa/ dkar/ nag /dmar ba'i zhal gsum 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa zhi ba'i nyams can/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug gu rtse gsum dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ smin ma dang sma ra 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sha rgyas pa bongs thung ba/ snying gar me'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa mdog ris kyi mtshan ma la raṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ gos dkar po bgos shing srad bu dkar po se ral khar thogs pa/ me lce dkar po'i 'od zer stong gis dkrigs pa padma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur par bsam| 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang bcas la/ hūm̐ ṭakki rā dza hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod rgyal spros te/ ri rab kyi shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa'i tshogs skad cig gis spyan drangs| zhes mos nas/ lag g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma bzung*/ g.yas ku sha dang bcas te mi 'jigs pa'i rgya las mthe bong srin lag gi rtsa bar 'dzugs pa mi 'jigs pa skyod pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ e hi e hi ma hā bhu ta/ de wa ṛ ṣi dwi dza satta/ ma gri hī twa ā hu ti ma hā/ asmin sanni hi to bha wa/ zhes gur dang sambu ṭa las 'byung ba ltar rgya skad dam| yang na bod skad du/ oṃ/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog

/sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod| |ces so// oṃ agna ye/ ā dī bya ā dī bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya ka bya/ bā ha na ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐/ zhes spyan drangs/ rang byung chen po bcom ldan 'das// 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'dod pa ster// me lha las kun sgrub byed pa// 'dir ni gdan la nye bar bzhugs// ku sha ā sa naṃ ku ru/ zhes brjod pas thab kyi me mtshams kyi kha khyer du ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ sngags tshig 'di ni ye shes thig le las byung ngo*// skabs 'dir rig pa mchog las/ me lha byon pa'i rtags su gyur pa ni me'i dbus su sngo breng 'dug pa dang mtha' sngo ba dang*/ me'i rtse mo rgyas pa dang rtsa ba sngo zhing rgyas pa 'byung*/ zhes kyang gsungs so// de nas/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs thams cad oṃ suṃ bha ni'i sngags dang yungs kar gyis brab/ las sngags brjod cing bsang chu gtor bas bskrad/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo/ nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'og nas 'byung ba lta bus mchod nas/ rdor dril 'dzin pa'i 'khyud tshul se gol dang bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhoḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ dbang bskur ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum pa bsnams nas| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/

yang dbang bskur mi byed na/ lha bskyed pa'i tshe nas snang mtha'i cod pan can du bsgom par bya'o// mchod pa ni/ thog mar chu bzhi 'bul tshul bsdus par na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐/ zhes pa lta bu'am/ 'bring la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra satkā raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ sogs/ rgyas par na/ oṃ agna ye/ zhes pa nas/ bā ha na ye zhes pa'i bar spyan 'dren gyi skabs lta bu'i mthar/ arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes pa lta bu/ de gsum gang byed kyang*/ arghaṃ gyis mchod yon/ ā tsa mā naṃ gyis zhal bsil/ prokṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor/ pā dyaṃ gyis zhabs bsil rnams 'bul/ de nas/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapad zhes sogs me lha'i sngags btags pa'am/ rkyang pas kyang rung ste nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ agna ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bdud rtsis nang mchod dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga yā mi/ zhes gsang mchod kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭakkis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces bstod/ dbang du bya ba ni/ 'di la rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang*/ rtse lnga pa dang*/ grub pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya dang*/ me lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya sogs mang du bshad kyang lag len bde ba'i phyir/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan lhag ma gsum brkyangs pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badzra a na la/ ma hā bhū ta/ dzwa la dzwa lā ya/ sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dṛ shya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes gur nas gsungs pa lan gsum brjod/ me lha rang gi dam tshig la gnas par gyur par bsam/ spro na/ phyag rgya gzhan rnams kyang byar rung ngo*// de nas dgang blugs 'bul ba ni/

lag g.yon byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya kha gyen du bstan pas dgang gzar mar gyis gang ba bzung*/ g.yas phyag rgya de nyid thur du spub pas blugs gzar mar gyis gang ba kha gyen du phyogs par dgang gzar gyi steng du bzung la/ me lha'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje'i rnam pa can dkar po la raṃ yig dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ 'od zer dang bcas pa yi ge rnams phan tshun 'od zer kun tu 'khrugs pa'i sreg blugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te/ me lha 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i ngo bor tshim par gyur par dmigs nas/ lag gnyis pus mo'i nang las phyir mi 'da' bar g.yas su bskor zhing 'bul/ dgang blugs kyi kha zhes pa mtsho skyes dang*/ dam tshig rdo rjes dgang blugs kyi nang dang*/ mi thub zla bas nang gi rdo rje'i lte bar dgod par gsungs so// 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ sngar bshad pa'i oṃ agna ye zhes pa nas/ bā ha na ye swā hā/ zhes sngags ring ngam/ oṃ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs kyi sngags la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ zhes sreg blugs kyi sngags btags pa'i swā hā'i gong du/ che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru/ zhes sbyar ba lan bdun nam gsum dbul/ de yang sngags bzla ba'i tshe gong ltar dgang blugs kha gyen du bstan pa brtsegs shing 'bul ba'i tshe gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar nas g.yas su bskor zhing 'bul/ 'di la byon zan du grags so// de ltar phul bas/ me lha dgyes bzhin du bzhes te bsreg bya 'dzin pa'i dam tshig la gnas nas sreg blugs len zhing*/ bya ba bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par gyur par bsam/ skabs 'dir sngar bshad pa ltar me pra brtags nas ngan na/ me la bsang gtor dang*| 'dod lha'i gtso bo'i sngags la/ bgegs thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes btags pas dgang blugs bdun dang*/ bsang gtor byas nas me lha'i sngags ring gis dgang blugs bdun nam gsum 'bul/ me pra bzang na de rnams mi dgos so// de nas rdzas 'bul ba ni/ yaṃ shing byang chub kyi shing du mos la g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pas yaṃ shing zung re thogs pas g.yon pa'i steng nas phyi ngos su 'og nas steng du bskor zhing rtse mo lhar phyogs pas 'bul/ skor tshul 'di ni mar khu ma gtogs rdzas bcu gnyis po kun la sbyor| yaṃ shing la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du/ mar khu dgang blugs kha sbyar ba'am/ blugs gzar rkyang pas 'bul zhing*/ oṃ agna ye che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par sdig pa'i gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ yungs kar la/ oṃ sarba artha sā dha ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par bgegs kyi gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba sampa de che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par bde ba mchog la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā| ku sha zung du sbyar ba la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par srung ba mchog la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dūrba zung du sbyar ba la/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par tshe phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/

nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par myur ba'i shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri ye che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par bsod nams rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par lus kyi stobs rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ badzra bi dzā ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par nor dang 'bru rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ shing thog rnams la/ oṃ a sa manta pha la ya che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dang khyad par rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes 'bul/ yaṃ shing la/ oṃ badzra ya dzñā ya/ zhes yaṃ shing spyi'i sngags sam/ yang na/ oṃ badzra ku be rā ya swā hā/ zhes 'o ma can gyi shing spyi'i sngags dang*/ shing thog sna tshogs la/ oṃ ga ga ni ga ga ni bi lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sam/ yang na/ oṃ badzra sho ba le swā hā/ bilba dang star ka sogs kyi'o/ zhes mnyam sbyor nas gsungs pa'ang yod pas snga ma gnyis dang gang bde byed chog /de dag spro na/ oṃ agna ye bo dhi bṛkṣa ya/ zhes sam/ mi spro na/ rdzas sngags rkyang pas kyang rung ngo*// rdzas khyad par ba la me lha'i sngags mthar/ bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ btags nas 'bul/ de rnams kyang bdun nam/ nyer gcig /brgya phrag sogs lcogs tshad du 'bul/ rdzas re re'i mthar rol chen yang bya ste/

'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rgyal sgra rnga ni pa ṭa ha// rnga bo che yi sgra dag ni// brtson byas sgrub par ma lus 'gyur// sbyin sreg las las yang dag brten// zhes gsungs so// 'ga' zhig dgang blugs gnyis ka mar gyis bkang nas 'bul ba dgang blugs dang*/ blugs gzar rkyang pa mar gyis bkang nas 'bul ba sreg blugs yin zhes pa'i dbye ba ni ches mi 'thad de/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel las/ dgang ba'i sreg blugs te dgang gzar mar gyis bkang nas zhes dgang gzar gyis 'bul ba'ang sreg blugs su bshad do// des na sreg blugs zhes pa spyi ming ste/ sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ zhes 'byung la/ dgang blugs ni dgang gzar mar gyis bkang nas 'bul ba'i sgos ming ngo*// bhu wa blo ldan gyis/ mi dang ma he rnga mong dang*// ce spyang rta dang glang po yi// sha ni dngos grub 'dod pa des// rnal 'byor rig pas sbyin sreg bya// zhes gsungs pas/ spro na/ bla med la sha sna tshogs 'bul bar gsungs pas zas mchog la bsre'o// rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la ni mi rung ngo*// de ltar rdzas rnams snyan pa'i gdangs dang bcas phul nas/ slar chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod cing*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gis bstod do/ gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ sngar bshad pa'i me lha'i phyag rgya bstan nas/ oṃ agna ye dzu hu dzu hu/ zhes brjod/ se gol gsum gtogs pas/ me lha thab kyi nang du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhal gyi sgo'i dam tshig 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ zhes pa'i sngags tshig ni gdan bzhi nas gsungs so// de nas me dang mchod rdzas sreg rdzas rnams la las sngags kyis bsang gtor byas nas/ rang nyid 'khor lo'i dbang phyug zhi ba'i nyams can gyi thugs ka nas rnam snang yab yum dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can/ gos rgyan dkar po can/ zla ba chu shel gyi bum pa 'dzin pa rang 'dra'i 'khor mang po spro ba dang bcas pas spros/

bsgrub bya la dbang bskur bas/ de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur bar bsam/ lha bskyed pa ni/ me lha me dpung 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur pa'i dbus su/ rgyas pa na/ 'byung rim nas sam/ yang na/ gzhal yas khang lha dang bcas pa'am/ bsdu na gdan lha dang bcas pa bskyed/ gtso bo'i rtsa zhal dang sku mdog /'khor rnams kyi kha dog dang bcas pa dkar por bsgyur/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed nas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha mtshan steng du me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa lhar bsams nas spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyis lha so so'i sngags kyi me tog thab tu dor bas rang rang gi gdan la 'khod par bsam/ de nas sgrub mchod dang 'brel lam ma 'brel yang rung*/ spyan 'dren nas bsnyen pa'i bar rang gzhung ltar bya zhing long dang bstun pa'i bsnyen pa brgya sogs ci 'grub bya/ de nas gtso bo'i ljags lha rang rang gi mdog can rdo rje'i sbu gu can la rang rang gi sa bon dkar pos mtshan par gyur par dmigs nas/ gtso bo'i snying po la dgang blugs kyi sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa btags pa lan bdun byon zan du 'bul/ phrin las gang bcol mdzad pa zhal gyis bzhes par gyur par bsam/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud rim par phye ba bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa las/ me ni tshims byas 'bar ba yi// rnam par yongs su thim par gyur// de nas me dbus bdag gi lha// rgyan dang na bza' kha dog sogs// las kyi rjes su mthun par ni// bsam zhing me yi mtshan ma brtag /ces gsungs 'dug pas/ me pra brtag pa sngar bshad pa'i me lha'i skabs sam/ yang na skabs 'dir me pra brtag pa yang rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang mthun par snang ngo*// mchod pa rnams rang gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pa me lha'i skabs ltar bya/ rang rang gi bstod pas bstod/

de nas 'jig 'das gnyis kyi sreg rdzas sngar mnyam du bkru sbyang byas zin na des mthus/ sngar 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i ma gtogs 'das pa'i sreg rdzas byin gyis ma brlabs na sngar ltar rdzas bkru sbyang byin rlabs gong ltar 'dir bya/ 'on kyang 'jig 'das mnyam du bkru sbyang byin rlabs gong ltar byas pa lag len bde'o// spro na skabs 'dir gdan gzhi las/ me yi dbus su kun rig pas// de nas sbyang ba brtsam par bya// oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi phaṭa/ rdo rje bcas pa'i lag pa yis// me tog yungs kar chu yis ni// phyogs kun tu ni gtor nas su// me yi nang du blug par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ las mthun gyi mdog can gyi me tog dang*/ yungs kar chu gtsang dang bcas pa me'i phyogs mtshams dang thab rdzas mchod pa thams cad la gtor zhing*/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi phaṭa/ ces brjod la/ mi spro na 'di nyid ma byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas gtso bo nas 'khor gyi bar so so'i lha sngags mthar/ rdzas sngags spel tshig dang bcas btags pa gtso bo la brgya la sogs pa dang*/ 'khor rnams la lnga bcu'am nyer gcig sogs ci nus 'bul la/ spros pa chung ba dag gis ni/ gtso bo'i snying po'am/ las sngags rkyang pa la spel tshig btags nas gtso 'khor lhan cig tu 'bul zhing*/ de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ gtso bo'i ljags la bstabs pas lha thams cad kyis thob par bsam pa'am/ yang na/ gtso 'khor thams cad ljags tha mi dad du dmigs nas phul bas lha thams cad la phul bar 'gyur ba shanti pas bshad do// rdzas khyad par ba rdzas sngags med pa rnams ni lha'i sngags nyid kyis bsreg go// deng sang gcig bcu sogs grangs rkun byed pa snang mod/ de ni lha la'ang 'gro 'tsham gyis byas la ma bsags kyi sbyin sreg rnam par nongs so// gtso 'khor so sor grangs mang du 'bul na skabs skabs su me gso ba'i phyir dgang blugs gsum/ lnga/ bdun sogs gang dgos re dbul lo// de ltar dngos gzhi'i bsdoms ni/

thab bsang thab dang me lha bskyed// spyan drang bzhugs gsol bgegs bskrad cing*// chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang*// nang dang gsang mchod gnyis med bstim// dbang bskur rgyas gdab chu bzhi dang*// nyer spyod rol mo nang gsang mchod// bstod cing dam bzhag byon zan 'bul// pra brtag ngan na bsang gtor dang*// gtso bo'i sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun// bsang gtor dang ni me lha yi// sngags kyis 'gang blugs bdun nam gsum// 'bul gyi bzang na de mi dgos// yam shing mar khu til yungs kar// zas mchog ku sha durba nas// gro 'bras sran so 'bras bu sogs/ */phul nas chu bzhi nyer spyod rol/ */nang gsang gis mchod bstod pa bya// sngags rgyas me lha 'bar bar bsgyur// thab rdzas bsang zhing bsgrub bya la// zhi ba'i las bya me yi dbus// rten dang brten bskyed spyan 'dren nas// bsnyen pa'i bar bya byon zan 'bul// mchod pa byin rlabs chu bzhi dang*// nyer spyod rol mo nang gsang bas// mchod cing bstod nas gtso bo la// rdzas rnams brgya stong la sogs dang*// 'khor la de phyed la sogs 'bul// gsum pa rjes ni/ gtso bo'i snying pos sreg blugs gsum/ lnga bdun nyer gcig gang rung dang*/ yang gtso bo'i sngags kyis dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su phul nas/ chu bzhi 'bul/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu sogs sho lo ka dang*/ oṃ badzra wast+ra ya swā hā/ gos zung dang*/ oṃ badzra tambu lā ya swā hā/ so rtsi 'bul/ sngar ltar chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo nang gsang gis mchod cing bstod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul| slar mchod yon phul nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ma snyed yongs su ma shes dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun gtso bos bzod par rigs// zhes dang*/

yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*| |slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dbus su rang sngags bcug pa'i mthar/ badzra muḥ ye shes kyi lha tshogs rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas/ rang gi dbugs rngub pa dang lhan cig tu dam tshig pa rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na/ slar yang me tog gis mtshon nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs te so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ de yang gdan bzhi las/ drangs nas dbugs kyi dngos gyur te// rang gi lus la bstim par bya// de nas rang gi lus nyid du// mkhas pa yis ni bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs so// de nas thab las sngags kyi bsang chus bsangs nas/ me lha'i sngags kyis sreg blugs gcig phul bas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las slar sku mdog phyag mtshan dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ chu bzhi 'bul/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu sogs kyis gos zung dang*/ tambu las so rtsi 'bul/ yam shing nas shing thog gi bar gyi rdzas rnams sngar me lha'i skabs kyi sngags spel tshig dang bcas pas lan gsum re bsreg /'dir ni gsum re kho nar nges te/ gdan bzhi las/ lhag ma lan gsum bsregs nas kyang*// zhes gsungs pas/ so sor gsum re'am/ mi lcogs na rdzas rnams bsres te lan gsum bsreg /lhag ma med par bya/ de nas me lha'i sngags ring gis dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su 'bul/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes bstod do// gzhan don gyi skabs/ slob ma dang yon bdag gi bya ba 'ga' zhig mchis pa ni 'dir ma spros so// gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/

oṃ agna ye a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs gsum dang*/ nyer spyod lnga dang rol mos mchod nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub mdzod kyi bar gyis gtor ma phul nas phrin las bcol/ gang yang bdag blo sogs gsum dang*/ yi ge brgya pa gsum gyis lhag chad bskang*| bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za bar gshegs// ji lta'i dus su slar byon la// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// dza hi dza hi oṃ muḥ zhes se gol lan gsum gtogs shing gshegs su gsol/ de yang bram ze rin chen rdo rjes/ dza hi dza hi zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ zhes gsungs so// skabs 'dir drag po sogs 'jig rten pa'i lha la sbyin pa dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug sogs thab tu bskyed nas cho ga 'dis byin na sbyin pa chen por 'gyur bar gsungs kyang*/ deng sang lag len byed pa nyung la/ rdzas lhag mas 'o thug gi bya ba byas na/ sdig pa 'dag par gsungs kyang deng sang byed pa nyung phyir ma spros/ de nas bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab ste/ gdan bzhi las/ bkra shis dbyangs ni blangs nas su// zhes so// de nas me de dag long yod na ma shi'i bar du gdal dkrug dang 'gong ba sogs mi bya bar rang zhir gtang*/ long med na 'o ma dang dri dkar po'i chus gzhil/ thal sol rnams las bum du blugs nas rgyun 'bab kyi chur bskyal zhing chu de nas bum pa gang khyer nas gnas khang gi phyi nang thams cad du gtor bas bkra shis par 'gyur bar gsungs/ spros pa la dga' na/ thal sol bum par blugs shing gos kyis bklubs pa rgyan gyis spras pa'i do lir bzhag ste/ spos dang rol mos sna drangs nas rgya mtshor dor ba sogs gong bzhin bya/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar mjug gi bsdoms
